answer_1.quote: Given an input search query, search engines such as Google and Bing , not only return the URLs and the titles of the relevant webpages, but also show the query-aware snippets of these webpages, aiming to help users better understand the webpage content before clicking.

answer_2.quote: We use precision@k (k=1,3,5) as the evaluation metrics for performance on the snippet extraction test dataset, accuracy (ACC) as the evaluation metric for performance on the manually labeled test dataset, floating-point operations (FLOPs) and million seconds (ms) as the evaluation metrics for efficiency.

answer_4.quote: Since there is no off-the-shelf dataset for query-aware snippet extraction, we first manually labeled two small English and Multi-lingual datasets, of which the task is to select the more proper snippet given a pair of candidate sentences.
answer_4.guideline: select the more proper snippet given a pair of candidate sentences
